scenario: [LCDB.5.5] / [LGRA.6.6.7]: a negative duration on a rule rate-modifier is refused with DS_VALIDATE_RATE_NEGATIVE_DURATION. The Mercury parser takes the modifier's span whole, so `cooldown -5_min` parses and reaches the validator with `-` as the span's first token; it is not a parse error. PATH PINNED: dsc.validate.lcdb_5_5_negative over a `cooldown` span. Zero stays legal (LCDB.5.6).
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r cooldown -5_min:
    Trig
->
    log info "x"
